comments.note: TaggerViewModel subscribes to ITagsManager.DataChanged in the constructor but never unsubscribes. The VM is not IDisposable, so the event subscription keeps it alive for the lifetime of ITagsManager (a singleton). A future WP should implement IDisposable and have the Tagger control code-behind call Dispose() on Unloaded. Noted as out-of-scope for WP-016 per constraints.

TaggerTagViewModel.OnIsCheckedStoredChanged uses a fire-and-forget task discard (_ = callback(...)). Exceptions from connect/disconnect are silently swallowed. A future improvement would route failures back through an error notification channel (e.g. a shared IErrorBus or a StatusBarViewModel).

The three category commands (AddCategoryAsync, EditCategoryAsync, DeleteCategoryAsync) are stubs returning Task.CompletedTask. They will remain until ICategoryEditorService is introduced in a later WP; the stubs are already self-documented via XML comments.

FindImpliedViaLabel iterates _storedTagIds and calls GetEffectiveTagIds once per stored tag, resulting in O(stored * graph_size) work. For large tag graphs this could be optimised by building a reverse-closure map in ITagsManager, but for typical collection sizes (< 200 stored tags) the cost is negligible.

comments.note: Fix-Forward: extracted magic number 50 from ComputeDepth cycle guard into named constant MaxTagDepth=50 (TaggerViewModel.cs). Non-behavioral — no logic change.

Fix-Forward: corrected the IsVisible XML doc comment in TaggerTagViewModel.cs. Original comment stated 'false only when the tag is explicitly hidden by the filter', but ApplyFilter never sets IsVisible=false (only IsDimmed changes with filter). Updated doc to accurately state that FilterText changes only affect IsDimmed; IsVisible is reserved for explicit hide/show without removing from collection. Non-behavioral: doc comment only.

[documentation-forward] TaggerViewModel.DeleteTagAsync command calls _tagsManager.DeleteTagAsync directly without a confirmation dialog. The api-surface.md entry for TaggerViewModel should note that this is intentional for WP-016 scope (no ICategoryEditorService or ITagDeleteService yet) and that a confirmation UX should be wired in a future WP.

QA-flagged edge case (IsVisible always true after filter) is intentional by design. IsVisible is reserved for explicit hide/show semantics; FilterText uses IsDimmed for visual dimming only. AC-4 wording ('updates IsVisible/IsDimmed') could cause future confusion — the actual behavior is IsDimmed-only for FilterText. Addressed by Fix-Forward doc comment update.

TaggerViewModel.RebuildCategories calls Categories.Clear() on every DataChanged event, triggering one CollectionChanged notification per removed item. For large catalogs this causes UI churn. A future improvement could use a diff-based update strategy. At typical catalog scale (< 200 tags) the cost is negligible. Not blocking.
